description: Weekly refresh config for data/lenders.json. Each target is one lender product rate-card page. scripts/scrape-lenders.js fetches every target (unless enabled:false), extracts the fields with the regex patterns below (a per-target patterns object overrides defaultPatterns; a per-target fields array overrides defaults.fields), diffs against data/lenders.json, writes the updated file and regenerates data/lenders.ts. It then walks the `eligibility` block below and re-checks each lender's published minimum income, minimum CIBIL, business vintage, annual turnover and education collateral threshold from its own eligibility page. Those fields decide who the Loan Check ranking tells a borrower to apply to, so a difference is reported and HELD for review (logged and written to data/eligibility-drift.json), never written silently — see `eligibility.note`. LIVE AUTOMATION: a weekly platform schedule ('Weekly lender rate refresh') triggers the 'weekly-lender-refresh' server-function hook, which runs this same target list + guards server-side, writes fresh values into the WorkspaceDB table lender_rate_overrides, logs every change in lender_rate_updates, and posts the change log to the founder's chat. REACHES CUSTOMERS (wired 2026-08-12): lib/lender-rates-live.ts loads lender_rate_overrides once per page (a shared read — the rows are workspace-owned with session_id NULL) and layers the rows over the static data/lenders.ts bundle, so a weekly write reaches borrowers on their next page load with no republish. Both live surfaces — apps/LoanCheck and the loanley-compare chat card (components/LenderCompareCard.tsx) — pass that merged database to compareLenders(). The merge re-applies the `sanity` band below: a rate outside minPlausibleRatePct..maxPlausibleRatePct, a processing fee outside (0%, 10%], or a pair that would invert a lender's published range is dropped and the bundled value for that field stands; the newest row wins per lender+product; an empty or unreachable table renders exactly the bundled rates. apps/LenderRates is retired and unregistered — it is not the customer path. Updating data/lenders.json, regenerating data/lenders.ts (node scripts/scrape-lenders.js --sync) and republishing is still how the bundled baseline itself moves. Keep this file and the hook's embedded config in sync: after editing targets here, update the hook code via PATCH /api/workspaces/253940/hooks/{hookId}.

sanity.note: Extracted rates outside the plausible band are discarded. In the local script, changes larger than reviewThresholdPct are applied but flagged REVIEW in the log. In the live weekly hook, REVIEW changes (delta > reviewThresholdPct, or a rate more than 3pp outside the lib/loan-benchmarks band for the product) are HELD — recorded in lender_rate_updates with status 'review' and surfaced to the founder, never auto-applied.

eligibility.note: Eligibility monitoring. minSalary, minCreditScore, minBusinessVintageMonths, minAnnualTurnover and collateralRequiredAboveAmount are what the Loan Check ranking filters borrowers on, so they are NEVER overwritten silently: scripts/scrape-lenders.js reports every difference between the lender page and data/lenders.json under 'Eligibility drift', writes it to data/eligibility-drift.json and keeps the stored value until a human confirms it and re-runs with --apply-eligibility. A wrong minimum here either sends a borrower to a lender that will reject them or hides one that would have said yes. 'no plausible X found' in the run log means the stored value could not be verified from the page — not that it is fine.
eligibility.reuseRateTargetsNote: Rate-card pages for personal, home and loan-against-property products also publish the minimum income and CIBIL, so every enabled rate target above doubles as an eligibility target for the default fields. Add eligibilityUrl / eligibilityFields / eligibilityEnabled to a rate target to point its eligibility check elsewhere. The explicit targets below win over the reused ones, and a target listed below with enabled:false is left unmonitored on purpose rather than falling back to the rate page.

sanity.note: Extracted eligibility values outside these bands are discarded as page noise (nav labels, marketing copy, unrelated tables) and the stored value is kept and flagged unverified.
